Competent: Demonstrates consistent accuracy of grammar, punctuation, sentence structure, spelling, and word usage. Errors, if present, are minor and do not interfere with clarity or meaning.
Approaching Competency: Demonstrates developing understanding of grammar and mechanics. Noticeable errors in sentence structure, punctuation, or word usage may slightly affect clarity.
Not Competent: Frequent or significant errors in grammar, sentence structure, punctuation, or word usage that interfere with clarity and understanding.

Competent: Demonstrates professional demeanor through respectful communication, accountability, and adherence to academic conduct standards. Consistently contributes to a positive and collaborative environment.
Approaching Competency: Demonstrates basic professional behaviors with occasional lapses in communication, or accountability. May need reminders to engage ethically or respond appropriately to feedback.
Not Competent: Frequently displays unprofessional behaviors such as poor communication, lack of preparation, or disregard for ethical or collaborative expectations. Fails to respond appropriately to feedback.

Competent: Completes a reference section and intext citations giving credit to source(s) used. Reference(s) are less than 5 years old and are from a textbook or peer-reviewed journal. Reference(s) is/are made using APA 7th edition style and contain the author(s), date of publication, and source.
Approaching Competency: Completes a reference section giving credit to source(s) used. Reference(s) are less than 5 years old and are from a textbook or peer-reviewed journal. Reference(s) is/are made using APA 7th edition style. One or more of the following is missing from the reference: author(s), date of publication, and/or source. Or each reference in the section does not have an applicable intext citation.
Not Competent: Reference(s) are more than 5 years old or are not from a textbook or peer-reviewed journal OR one or more of the following is missing from the reference: author(s), date of publication, and/or source. Or intext citations are missing.
